graph_and_feature_stage_timing.denominators: Seven full graphs;32motifs/node; expected total=sum(expected_nodes*32) across seven unique graph hashes. Completed graph cells credited only after genuine retained verification; failed partial batches are not whole-graph completion. Resource scope one update,16decisions/28lookback/512originalsamples; not a completed fit.
graph_and_feature_stage_timing.feature_limitation: Full MCM generation per graph is timed. Subsequent torch tensor views, edge conversions, tensor contract hashing and batch_factory setup have no dedicated feature-generation elapsed receipt. GAT and attention-LSTM feature work inside forward is not separately timed in these sources. Do not call numeric memo seconds whole feature-generation time.
graph_and_feature_stage_timing.timing: MCMMeasurements.begin immediately before produce_imported; completed after result.check and verify_retained. Thus each completed graph elapsed includes preparation, matching, boundaries, publication and retained verification, excluding preceding outer watch.check. Events are cumulative since caller began; original_import/mcm-{hash}/one_update_checkpoint_readback are milestones, not separate stopwatch values. Measurements/events live in memory until final summary publication, so absence during active job is normal.

joint_update_timing.interpretation: Before/after events bracket phase function with fsync overhead; authoritative seconds[phase] is function-only stopwatch, excludes surrounding authority_check. End-to-end training elapsed includes checks/setup/untimed gaps; sum phase seconds is not full training time. Forward/backward/clip/optimizer are joint model operations; no separate GAT/LSTM durations established. A before without after indicates unfinished or failed phase, not completed update. Complete requires optimizer_steps1 plus checkpoint/readback; failed optimizer_step_started distinguishes attempt from committed step. Read only time/status/count fields; do not inspect loss, gradients, checkpoint.pt, targets or prices.

legitimate_throughput_and_eta.eta: Only conditional same-regime ETA=(known expected cells-current published covered)/observed wall cells_per_second, reported with window and reuse fraction. Unknown active phase, absent prefix, changing graph shapes/reuse ratio or unmeasured publication/training prevents credible whole-job ETA. Numeric-only ETA omits mandatory overhead and cannot predict native deadline success. Prefer retain several actual windows; do not start a new monitor.
legitimate_throughput_and_eta.numeric_rate: For a contiguous published prefix with positive sum(elapsed_seconds), covered/sum elapsed measures inclusive memo occurrence throughput; computed/sum elapsed is computed-cell throughput over mixed computed/reused work, not pure solve latency. Excludes batch guards, summary write/readback, graph loading and external offload.
legitimate_throughput_and_eta.prior29: Prior29 report/index describes52 published batches,212992 covered (208448computed/4544reused) and cumulative-counter deltas. Reuse semantics only; compiled34/phase changes and different cache/graph state make those historical rates unsuitable as current throughput or full-population ETA.
legitimate_throughput_and_eta.wall_rate: Root may compare covered stop deltas against its own two actual monotonic observations of same graph/owner; observation interval includes stall/guard/offload time but endpoints are publication snapshots. This is measured interval throughput, not a completion certificate.

limits: Exactly five frozen source files inspected; no active receipts/processes/arrays/testlabels queried, no monitoring launched.
No numerical/scientific imports, tests, Git, live source/registration/claim changes.
No observed pilot34 progress, actual ETA, speedup, training success or financial claim. Root remains sole actual process observer.

mcm_complete.numeric_binding: batched.numeric_execution fields cells/computed/reused/batches/elapsed_seconds/counters; computed+reused==cells. This is written only after execution finish and boundaries; final stage/output verification still follows.
mcm_complete.producer_start_same_directory: start.json contains rows,motifs,cells,scope; exists only after preparation and entry checks, not at graph attempt start. Producer directory expression is not re-opened in this five-source budget; resolve exact path from genuine public result/output receipt rather than infer workflow identity.

mcm_numeric_progress.counting: Sum computed and reused separately over unique published batches. Covered cells=sum(computed+reused). Unpublished in-progress batch unknown; zero published files does not mean zero computation. Separate each graph/NumericExecution owner when resetting cumulative counters.
mcm_numeric_progress.publication: _complete_batch first invokes memo.end_batch genuine guard, then writes+fsyncs origin bytes, writes exclusive JSON, readbacks+fsyncs directory. A file can be seen before writer readback finishes; a single live pathname alone is not completed stage authority. Read only bounded stable complete JSON, retain original hash, validate contiguous nonoverlapping batch/start/stop and computed+reused==stop-start. No numeric-origins.bin/score/array reading needed for observational progress; final verified binding establishes stronger completion.

schema.counters: cumulative per NumericExecution owner; subtract successive samples, never sum cumulative values
schema.elapsed_seconds: THIS batch sum of perf_counter intervals directly around memo calls

namespace_rule: Root must obtain actual34 representation namespace from genuine current public owner/entry receipt. Never substitute prior29/33 namespace. compact stage-root template follows prior29 actual receipt index and current _compute(stage.root) joining; no active34 directory was inspected here.
